import copy

def merge(base, override):
    """Merge two settings dicts. Nested dicts are merged key by key."""
    # deep copy base to avoid mutation
    result = copy.deepcopy(base)
    for k, v in override.items():
        if k in result and isinstance(result[k], dict) and isinstance(v, dict):
            result[k] = merge(result[k], v)
        else:
            # need deepcopy of v to avoid sharing
            result[k] = copy.deepcopy(v)
    return result

import copy

def merge(base, override):
    """Merge two settings dicts. Nested dicts are merged key by key."""
    # Deep copy base to avoid mutating inputs
    result = copy.deepcopy(base)
    for key, override_value in override.items():
        base_value = result.get(key)
        if isinstance(base_value, dict) and isinstance(override_value, dict):
            result[key] = merge(base_value, override_value)
        else:
            result[key] = copy.deepcopy(override_value)
    # Handle keys only in override already covered, keys only in base already in result
    # Also need to include any override keys not in base (already handled)
    return result
